text:
maya: hi everyone :wave: I'm Maya, starting today on product/design. Quick setup questions — I can log in with SSO but hitting a 403 when opening the main Figma files. Also where do you keep the canonical roadmap docs and who's the best person to ask about joining the next customer interview? any first-week priorities?

alex: welcome @maya! :tada: For Figma access ping @sam here and include your verified work email. Roadmap docs live in the product drive (link below) — if you can't open it we'll add you. First-week tip: sync with your PM, skim open PRDs, and join design crit on Thu.

sam: hey @maya — can you DM which email you used to sign into Figma? I'll check team permissions.

maya: maya.chen@redwood.com

it-bot: IT ticket #4472 created for Figma access request (requested by maya). Status: pending approval.

sam: invited maya.chen@redwood.com to the 'product-design' team in Figma and to the 'redwood-components' file. You should get an invite email — if not, check spam and let me know.

tanya: hi @maya, I'm Tanya (research). Our research playbook is here: https://redwood.inference/research-playbook.md — it covers recruitment, note-taking templates, and scheduling. We run interviewer shadowing sessions on Tues mornings; I'll add you to the research-docs folder and put you on the next session invite.

maya: thank you! can I also get access to the feature brief folder and the UX metrics board?

alex: added you to 'product/feature-briefs' in Drive and gave view on the UX metrics dashboard. Onboarding checklist (env, repos, docs): https://redwood.inference/onboarding-checklist — follow that and ping me if anything stalls.

maya: perfect, appreciate it. one small thing — any templates or quick prompts for writing up an early design critique?

sam: yes — we use a simple template in Figma comments: "TL;DR, problem, assumptions, proposed solutions, questions". For first week keep artifacts lightweight (one userflow + 2 mock variations).

maya: got it, thanks all! excited to be here :smile:

alex: welcome aboard again — shout here if you hit any blockers :boom:
